newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Two killed in Karachi violence.
newsitem.headline: Two killed in Karachi violence.

text.p: At least two people were killed in faction violence in the southern Pakistani port city of Karachi on Monday, police said.
They said a 45-year-old man named Luqman and annother man who had not been identified were kidnapped and tortured before being killed by gunshots at Orangi Extension in Karachi's District West.
No one claimed responsibility for the killings.
Factional fighting between the main Karachi-based ethnic Mohajir National Movement (MQM) and the breakaway Haqiqi faction have killed more than 60 people since February 3 general elections.
The latest deaths raised the toll to more than 115 in ethnic, sectarian and political violence in Karachi in 1997 compared to 500 in 1996 and 2,000 in 1995, doctors at government hospitals said.

The MQM, long involved in a struggle with the security forces as well as with Haqiqi, was brought into a coalition government in Sindh province, of which Karachi is the capital, after elections in February.
